name: Rewardful
summary: Affiliate and referral tracking for SaaS companies that bill through Stripe, with flat monthly pricing and a 14-day free trial.
best_for: SaaS and AI companies that bill through Stripe and want a dedicated affiliate and referral programme with a flat monthly fee
skip_if: you are not on Stripe or Paddle, your affiliate revenue is small enough that $49 a month is a poor fit, or you want a tool we have tested on a paid plan ourselves
honest_knock: The price is a flat fee, but it rises as affiliate revenue grows past $7,500 and $15,000 a month. Starter gives only 1 campaign and no branded portal. We have not paid for a plan, so tracking accuracy and setup time are unknown to us.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on rewardful.com/pricing, US dollars, taxes extra) Starter $49 a month or $490 a year (up to $7,500 a month in affiliate revenue, 1 campaign, 2 team members); Growth $99 a month or $990 a year (up to $15,000, unlimited campaigns, branded portal); Enterprise from $149 a month or $1,490 a year (up to $30,000 on the entry tier). 0% transaction fee. Managed Payouts optional, 3% processing fee. 14-day free trial on every plan. We have not paid for a plan.

schema_offer.description: Starter, per month; $490 a year; Growth $99 a month; Enterprise from $149 a month; tiers set by monthly affiliate-attributed revenue. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-17.

compare_with.name: Systeme.io
compare_with.why: Systeme.io bundles an affiliate programme inside an all-in-one business platform, while Rewardful is a dedicated tracker that connects to your own Stripe billing. Compare based on whether you already have a checkout.

purchase.how: AIBuilder Marketplace does not sell this software. Sign up, start a trial or buy on the vendor's site.
purchase.disclosure: Where purchase.affiliate is true, purchase.handoff_url is our own review page for the product; the vendor button on that page is a marked affiliate link and AIBuilder Marketplace may earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer. Commission never changes what a record says, and products are not ranked by commission. Where it is false the link is the vendor's plain site. sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in the Rewardful web app during the 14 day Starter trial. We set up a campaign with commission rules without connecting Stripe, opened the affiliate signup link, read the plan limits and cancelled the subscription the same day, before the first invoice.
findings: Sign-up: a card was required. The subscription page then showed Starter Monthly with Next invoice $49 on December 6, 2026, the day the 14 day trial ends.
Setup wizard: before any campaign it asks you to connect a payment processor, and Stripe and Paddle are the only two it offers.

First campaign: our first Create your first campaign click returned a generic system error. It worked once we picked a display currency in Company settings, which the app says cannot be changed later.
Campaign: we set 30% of each payment for 12 months, with commission pending for 30 days, without code. Rewardful set the cookie to 60 days by default.
Plan limits: private campaigns and private affiliate links were locked behind Upgrade to unlock on the Starter trial.
Affiliate signup link: the link shown on our new campaign page returned a page that said it doesn't seem to exist. Its address was built from our website field, with https- in the subdomain.
Cancelling: two clicks under Payments, Your Subscription. The status then read Cancels December 6, 2026.
not_tested: tracking a real referral through to a payment, because Stripe was not connected
payouts to affiliates through PayPal, Wise or Managed Payouts
the affiliate portal from the inside, because the signup link returned an error page
Growth plan features: custom domain, branded portal and private campaigns
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
